x: We trust we shall see more of Lee in our Club matches, as he is evidently a useful performer. High Jump: 1 R.
Held at Tooting Bec on June 5th, we had a full list of handicaps for Club members, and it was also decided to hold a School's relay race. We had five heats in the 100 Yards, and heat winners were R.

(Club record.) Shot Putt.—Pyramid Cup: 1st, Bergvalds, 35 ft. 7 ins.; 2nd, Melchoir, 34 ft. 4¾ ins.; 3rd, Higgins, 31 ft. 5½ ins. High Jump.—Harry Wright Shield: 1st, Mackenzie, 5 ft. 5 ins.; 2nd, Sinton, 5 ft.; 3, R.
